rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name + zip and confirmed both orders belonged to the same user. It retrieved order details before acting. For cancelling #W2702727, the agent followed policy: provided the refund total, requested explicit confirmation including a reason, executed the cancellation via tool, and confirmed the refund. However, for updating the shipping address on #W8268610, the agent executed the address modification without first restating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation prior to the write, which violates the requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. Final information given (refund total and remaining order total) matched tool data, but the unconfirmed write causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
